verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken skyscraper layout. The giant one-word-per-line headline takes most of the canvas. The CTA sits above the price cards and the subhead, so the reading order is reversed. The three price cards shrink to unreadable thumbnails, with YEARLY moved out of its central featured spot to the end. The legal text is cramped at the bottom. A's dark yearly card is also slightly oversized and off the shared top edge of the other cards, so B's evenly aligned row is marginally cleaner.
